annotations.title: Get a scheduled post's first comments

description:
[read-only] A post (`id` = convexPostId from publish, or posts[].id from get_content): status, slot, platforms, its full caption `text` (never cut), its name `displayTitle`, its `contentId`, its internal labels and per-platform/account instanceLabels, and while it is scheduled the first comment each platform will publish and whether it can be changed now.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

id.description: Format: string; e.g. "id_123". The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

name: get_post
